item.title: Not alive, but not dead: disembodied human brains used for drug testing
PopuLoRA: Co-Evolving LLM Populations for Reasoning Self- Play
item.description:
📝 Teachers generate verifiable tasks, students try to solve them, and the verifier supplies the reward. As students improve, teachers have to search for harder and broader tasks; as teachers diversify, students see a curriculum that keeps moving with them. PopuLoRAPopuLoRA separates task generation from task solving.
🔗 Read more: https://vmax.ai/team/populora-co-evolving-llm-populations-for-reasoning-self-play
